methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve motorized/gravity cold-therapy (cryotherapy circulation) units spanning consumer post-op coolers to clinical cold+compression systems, verified 2026-08-09 against manufacturer product pages (Breg, Enovis/DonJoy, Ossur, DJO/Aircast, Polar Products, Game Ready, ThermoTek, Vive Health, NICE Recovery Systems, Pain Management Technologies) and corroborated by authorized medical-supply retailers (DME-Direct, OrthoBracing, MyColdTherapy, ColdTherapy.us, Vitality Medical, Rehabmart, SchoolHealth, OrthoSTAT, MFI Medical); one adversarial correction was made to the seed list — "ThermoTek T505" is not a ThermoTek model (no such SKU appears anywhere on thermotekusa.com or any authorized dealer site), so the entry was replaced with ThermoTek's actual current flagship thermal/compression unit, the VascuTherm 5, the direct product a 2026 buyer would find under the ThermoTek name; several fields (reservoir capacity, weight, exact temperature range) were left null rather than guessed where no manufacturer or retailer source stated them, most notably for the NICE1 (an iceless, prescription/dealer-sold system with no published consumer purchase price — its rental rate and a secondary-market resale price are noted instead in priceNote), and no verifiably manufacturer-hosted product image could be confirmed for any of the twelve within the sources fetched, so the image field is omitted throughout rather than guessed.

products.name: Breg Polar Care Cube Cold Therapy System
products.priceNote: Cooler-only base price (OrthoBracing); complete kits bundled with a WrapOn pad run higher. Breg does not publish a fixed consumer MSRP on breg.com.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Knee (standard, large, XL), Shoulder (universal, XL), Ankle, Hip, Back, Multi-use XL, Hand/Wrist

products.provenance: Breg's own product page confirms motorized whisper-quiet pump technology, 6-8 hours of continuous cold therapy per fill, and the interchangeable pad lineup (knee, shoulder, ankle, hip, back, hand/wrist), noting the ankle pad is not compatible with the Cube and the back pad requires a back brace. A companion Breg spec page (coldtherapy.us, reproducing Breg's own IFU data for both the Cube and Kodiak) gives the 5-quart reservoir and 4.0 lb empty / 14.5 lb filled weight. No temperature-controlled digital timer is documented for the Cube (unlike the Active Ice 3.0's programmable timer), so treatment_timer is false. Price ($176.00, cooler only) from OrthoBracing; DME-Direct places complete systems in the $160-$200 range.

products.name: DonJoy IceMan CLASSIC3 Cold Therapy System
products.priceNote: Complete system price with Universal pad (MyColdTherapy.com); DonJoy does not display consumer MSRP on enovis.com/donjoystore.com.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Universal Cold Pad (standard, XL), Rectangle, Wrist/Hand, Ankle, McGuire Knee Wrap-On, Shoulder Wrap-On, Hip Wrap-On, Ankle/Fore-Foot Wrap-On; regular (6.5 in.) or extended (15 in.) hose

products.provenance: Enovis's own product page confirms a motorized recirculation system that remixes warmed pad-return water with cooler ice water for consistent cold delivery, plug-and-play self-priming operation, and the full pad/strap lineup. Walmart's listing corroborates the 8-quart opaque cooler and states up to 7 hours of continuous therapy per fill. No manufacturer or retailer source in this pass stated a net unit weight or an explicit outlet temperature range in °F, so both are left null rather than assumed from the similarly-built Clear3. Price $169.99 (complete system) per MyColdTherapy.com.

products.name: Ossur Cold Rush Cold Therapy System
products.priceNote: Cooler-only unit price (MyColdTherapy.com); complete kits with a pad cost more. Ossur does not display consumer pricing on ossur.com.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Knee, Shoulder, Hip, Lumbar/Back, Foot, and Universal pads (Ossur replacement-pad line)

products.provenance: Retailer spec sheets (Vitality Medical, Rehabmart, Ossur's own compatible-pad listings) reproducing Ossur's manufacturer data confirm a 4-liter (4.2 qt) reservoir, up to 6 continuous hours of cold therapy per fill, a 30-decibel brushless motorized pump positioned away from the reservoir, a front-panel flow-regulator dial to adjust temperature, and a 4.6 lb unit weight. No explicit outlet temperature range in °F was found on any fetched source, so temp_range_f is null. No built-in digital treatment timer is documented (flow-rate dial only), so treatment_timer is false. Price $169.99 (cooler only) per MyColdTherapy.com.

products.name: Aircast Cryo/Cuff IC Cold Therapy System
products.priceNote: Cooler unit only (Rehabmart.com); configurations bundled with a pad run $291-$300. DJO/Aircast does not publish direct consumer MSRP.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Ankle, Knee, Shoulder, Hip, Spine, Foot, Elbow, Thigh

products.provenance: Rehabmart's retailer spec copy (reproducing DJO/Aircast's own product literature) confirms the Cryo/Cuff IC is unique among this roster in offering both a gravity-fed mode and a motorized pump mode, plus an integrated pneumatic lid pump that runs a 30-second on/off intermittent-compression cycle alongside the cold water circulation (treatment_timer true, referring to this automated compression cycling rather than a countdown session timer). No reservoir capacity, unit weight, or outlet temperature range in specific units was located on any fetched source, so those fields are left null. Price $209.58 (cooler only) per Rehabmart; pad-inclusive configurations list at $291.32.

products.name: Polar Products Active Ice 3.0 Universal Cold Therapy System, 9-Quart
products.priceNote: 9-quart Universal configuration list price on polarproducts.com; the wheeled 16-quart version is priced higher.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Universal knee/joint pad (10.5 x 11.5 in.) with 3 x 44 in. elastic belt; separate shoulder, back/limb, full-circumference knee, and rectangular pad systems also sold

products.provenance: Polar Products' own product page states a 9-quart reservoir (holds up to six 500 ml frozen bottles), 5.5 lb dry weight, a high-efficiency whisper-quiet motorized pump, four adjustable coldness/flow levels, and a patent-pending programmable digital timer with custom on/off cycles in 10-minute increments up to 990 minutes (treatment_timer true). No specific outlet temperature range in °F is stated by the manufacturer (only relative "coldness levels"), so temp_range_f is null. Price $219.99 confirmed directly on polarproducts.com.

products.name: Game Ready GRPro 2.1 Cold & Compression Therapy Unit
products.priceNote: Control unit + AC adapter + 6 ft. connector hose (School Health / Cornish Medical); therapy wraps sold separately. Game Ready does not publish direct-to-consumer pricing on gameready.com.

specs.pad_wrap_options: ATX wraps sold separately (knee, ankle, shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, back, calf); compression levels High (5-75 mmHg), Medium (5-50 mmHg), Low (5-15 mmHg), or None

products.provenance: Game Ready's own product literature (patented ACCEL Technology: Active Compression and Cold Exchange Loop) states an ice-filled operating range of 35-50°F, selectable compression levels, and dimensions of 7.5 x 16 x 7.75 in. at 7.3 lb empty. No published reservoir volume in quarts/liters was found (the unit circulates from an internal ice chamber rather than a discrete measured reservoir), and no explicit built-in countdown timer is documented separately from the compression-cycle controls, so both reservoir_capacity_qt and treatment_timer are null. Price $3,037.99 for the control-unit kit, consistent across School Health, Cornish Medical, and Rehab Therapy Supplies.

products.name: ThermoTek VascuTherm 5 Thermal & Compression Therapy System
products.priceNote: Purchase price via OrthoSTAT Medical Supply, an authorized ThermoTek dealer. ThermoTek primarily distributes VascuTherm 5 through an insurance-billed dealer network and does not publish a direct consumer MSRP on thermotekusa.com; a 2-week rental option is also available (~$375 first two weeks, $125/week after, via SOS Medical).

specs.pad_wrap_options: Site-specific wraps and braces for cold, heat, intermittent pneumatic compression, and DVT/VTE prevention

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: "ThermoTek T505" does not exist as a ThermoTek product or SKU on thermotekusa.com, in ThermoTek's Revit model-drawing index, or on any authorized-dealer site checked (OrthoSTAT, SOS Medical, ColdCo Therapies) — the seed was replaced with ThermoTek's actual current flagship all-in-one thermal/compression device, the VascuTherm 5, the product a 2026 buyer would find under the ThermoTek name. ThermoTek's own product page confirms a touchscreen, physician-customizable profiles combining cold (43-49°F), heat, IPC compression, and thermal-contrast therapy, at 18.75 lb and 6.6 x 13.2 x 12 in., running on 110-240 VAC. No reservoir volume in quarts/liters is published (closed-loop fluid circuit, not an open ice reservoir), so that field is null. Price $6,995.00 per OrthoSTAT Medical Supply, corroborated by the parallel rental-rate structure documented at SOS Medical.

products.name: Vive Health Ice Therapy Machine (Cold Therapy Cooler & Pad)
products.priceNote: Current retail with universal pad (SupplyPT.com); Supply Cold Therapy lists the same kit from $222.99.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Universal therapy pad (12 x 11 in.) with small/medium/large elastic straps

products.provenance: Vive Health's own product page and the manufacturer product-data-sheet PDF (hosted by BSM Medical) confirm a 6-liter (6.3 qt) double-walled reservoir sized for 30-60 minute sessions per fill, a 5-foot connector hose, selectable timer settings of 5/10/15/20/25/30 minutes, a 12 x 11 in. universal pad with S/M/L straps, and a 6.84 lb unit weight. No outlet temperature range in °F was published, so temp_range_f is null. Price $279.99 (with pad) per SupplyPT.com; Supply Cold Therapy lists the identical kit from $222.99.

products.name: DonJoy IceMan CLEAR3 Cold Therapy Unit
products.priceNote: Cooler-only price (SupplyPT.com / Supply Cold Therapy); complete system with Universal XL pad lists at $169.99.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Universal, Knee, Shoulder, Ankle pads; regular or extended hose

products.provenance: Retailer product copy (Vitality Medical, Supply PT, reproducing DonJoy's own dual-pump recirculation-technology description) confirms the Clear3 uses the same recirculation system as the Classic3 in a translucent ~5-quart cooler so ice level is visible without opening the lid, providing 6-8 hours of continuous cold therapy per fill. No net unit weight was located on any fetched source, so unit_weight_lb is null; no built-in digital timer is documented, so treatment_timer is false. Price $118.99 (cooler only) per Supply PT / Supply Cold Therapy; complete kit with Universal XL pad $169.99.

products.name: Breg Polar Care Kodiak Cold Therapy System
products.priceNote: Cooler-only base price (ColdTherapy.us); pad-bundled and battery-pack configurations range $188.99-$296.99. Breg does not publish a fixed consumer MSRP on breg.com.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Intelli-Flo pads: knee, shoulder, ankle, back, hip, wrist

products.provenance: Breg's own product page describes the Kodiak as the most versatile unit in Breg's Polar Care line, the only battery-powered cold-therapy option on the market (four AA batteries powering 10-14 hours of motorized therapy in addition to 6-8 hours per fill on AC/pump power), paired with Intelli-Flo pads that tailor temperature by treatment area. A companion Breg spec page (coldtherapy.us, sharing the same manufacturer IFU data sheet used for the Cube) gives the 5-quart reservoir and 4.0 lb empty / 14.5 lb filled weight for both the Cube and Kodiak. No outlet temperature range in °F is separately published for the Kodiak, so temp_range_f is null. Price $169.99 (cooler only) per ColdTherapy.us; OrthoBracing lists the base unit at $188.99 and pad+battery bundles up to $296.99.

products.name: NICE1 Cold + Compression Therapy System
products.priceNote: NICE Recovery Systems does not publish a direct consumer purchase price; the NICE1 is sold through a prescription/authorized-dealer model. Rental runs $300 for the first two weeks and $200/week after (RecoveryForAthletes.com); a used unit with wrap sold for $2,499.99 on eBay as a secondary-market reference point. priceUsd left null rather than guessed at an MSRP.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Knee, shoulder, hip, ankle, elbow, wrist, lumbar, and cervical spine wraps

products.provenance: NICE Recovery Systems' own marketing page and authorized-dealer copy (Recovery For Athletes) confirm the NICE1 is an iceless system (uses only water, no ice) that circulates cooled water and compressed air through a therapy wrap via an internal motorized/compressor unit, with a touchscreen offering five cold-intensity levels and three compression pressures across eight wrap types, at 8 x 8 x 8 in. and 9 lb — described by the manufacturer as "the smallest and lightest cold and compression therapy machine on the market." Because it is iceless (no open water/ice reservoir to measure) and no manufacturer source states a specific outlet temperature range in °F, reservoir_capacity_qt, cooling_duration_hr, and temp_range_f are left null. No published direct-purchase price was found on getnice.com or its authorized dealers; only rental rates and a single secondary-market resale price were located, so priceUsd is null with those figures recorded in priceNote rather than treated as MSRP.

products.name: PMT Polar Vortex PV105 Ice Therapy Machine
products.priceNote: Sale price at MFI Medical; regular retail pricing varies by dealer (Rehabmart, Vitality Medical, Walmart all list the PV105 kit). PMT does not publish direct consumer pricing on its own site.

specs.pad_wrap_options: Universal adjustable-strap pad; 3-strap knee/elbow/shoulder wrap in kit versions

products.provenance: Authorized-dealer product copy (Rehabmart, MFI Medical, reproducing Pain Management Technologies' own description) confirms the Polar Vortex PV105 is a portable, motorized recirculating cold-water therapy machine with a clear insulated reservoir for at-a-glance ice-level visibility, foam-insulated connector tubing, and adjustable secure straps; kits bundle a knee/elbow/shoulder 3-strap wrap. No manufacturer source in this pass stated reservoir volume in quarts/liters, cooling duration in hours, outlet temperature range, unit weight, or a built-in digital timer, so those fields are null/false rather than assumed by analogy to similarly-styled competitors. Price $212.71 (sale) per MFI Medical.
